explication: VESC is embedded DC/BLDC/FOC motor-controller firmware. At boot, `main.c` initializes motor control, command handling, USB (when enabled), and application input handling; later, users and connected tools can control or configure the device through its communication interfaces. The runtime includes hardware-specific board support, motor-control and sensing subsystems, configurable input applications, and embedded Lisp extensions. Relationships below are limited to visible calls or source-index references; several subsystems are represented at their enclosing directory because their implementations were not excerpted.
